# A request body that is not JSON is not sent: the operation is left out.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'import "openapi:./api.yml": PUT /thing is left out: its request body is not JSON'
stderr 'app.sngl:4:16: unknown component'

-- app.sngl --
import api "openapi:./api.yml"

func ask() {
    var r = api.putThingCall()
}
-- api.yml --
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: T, version: "1"}
servers:
- url: https://api.example
paths:
  /thing:
    put:
      operationId: putThing
      requestBody: {content: {text/plain: {schema: {type: string}}}}
      responses:
        '200': {description: '', content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
